findings.title: SR-005 against SI-7: satisfied
findings.description:
Requirement SR-005: "The CC shall boot only boot-chain components signed with the project boot key, verified from a hardware root of trust."

VE-07 CI run 38345035945 at commit 0d3ca389ee65ba4575c00aad9b5130c4c416c5e5 reports `passed: true`, and test cases TC-01, TC-03, TC-04, TC-05, TC-10 are all `passed`. The SI-7 objective is therefore `satisfied` for SR-005 at this commit.
